Dot product — projection weighted by length

The 22 N force first projects 14.14 N onto the 8 N force direction. The dot product then multiplies that projected amount by the other vector’s 8 N magnitude: 14.14×8 ≈ 113.13 N². An area model makes that multiplication visible and distinguishes it from projection and cosine similarity.

Pause points (each sits on a 2s hold):

  • projection — 5.83s
  • dot product — 11.0s
  • area model — 15.17s
  • comparison — 20.92s
